name: scatter-chart
purpose: Accessible SVG scatter plot (and bubble chart when points have a size) of one or more series of (x, y) points on linear axes, with a toggleable legend, keyboard-reachable points in x order with tooltips, optional crosshair, optional zoom and pan along x or both axes, a generated summary, and a data table fallback. Series differ by color and marker shape, never by color alone.
whenToUse: Relationships or correlation between two numeric variables.
Clusters and outliers across a few groups (up to about 8 series).
A third numeric dimension as bubble size (sizes set on points).
whenNotToUse: Trends over an ordered x shared by all series: use Line Chart.
Comparing categories: use Bar Chart or Combo Chart.
Distribution of one variable: use Histogram (or Box Plot).
Very large point clouds (tens of thousands of points): not a target of this component.
states: zoomed (x or x and y window)
responsive: Width follows the container (ResizeObserver); height is the height option. Tick counts follow the plot size; the y axis width follows its labels. Reflows at 320 CSS px.
rtl: direction rtl mirrors the x axis (smallest x at the right), puts the y axis on the right, swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight; drag panning follows the mirrored axis. Legend, tooltip, and table follow the document direction.
theme: Colors from color-chart-1..8 by palette slot; gridlines color-chart-grid; axes color-chart-axis; text color-text / color-text-muted; tooltip color-surface with color-border-strong. Forced colors use CanvasText, Canvas, GrayText, and Highlight.
timezone: Not applicable: numeric and category axes only; no dates are formatted.
security: All text (title, description, labels, values, tooltip, table) is set with textContent; SVG is built with createElementNS. Colors are CSS classes; sizes and the tooltip position are written through the CSSOM (style.setProperty). No innerHTML, no style attributes, no inline handlers: works under style-src without unsafe-inline and require-trusted-types-for.
dataHandling: Renders the data it is given; no persistence, network access, or telemetry. Values are not logged; validation errors name the option, never its value.

budgets.metric: ScatterChart.create, 2,000 points, including the first render
budgets.budget: < 60 ms in headless Chromium (e2e performance test)

performance.testedScale: Measured in tests/e2e/perf-r3.spec.ts with 2,000 points. Above 600 visible points points are virtual (two proxy marks plus one decorative path per series), so DOM size is independent of point count. Hover uses a spatial hash. The data table is built only when opened (toggle mode).

limitations: Keyboard order within a series is by x (then y), not by data order.
Points without a size in a bubble chart are drawn as regular 4 px markers.
Axis label widths are estimated (about 0.6 em per character).
unsupported: Regression or trend lines, density contours.
Lasso or free-form selection; linked brushing across charts.
HTML content in labels or tooltips.
antiPatterns: More than about 8 series (colors and shapes start repeating).
Hiding the data table (dataTable: none) when users must read exact values.
Encoding critical meaning only in bubble size.
